response.original_title: South Park: Cartman's Mom Is A Dirty Slut
response.overview: This landmark two-part special event serves as South Park's very first major overarching storyline and television cliffhanger. The plot follows Eric Cartman's chaotic and desperate quest to uncover the identity of his biological father. As the town becomes obsessed with the mystery, a DNA test exposes his mother's highly promiscuous past, turning a private family crisis into a massive, hilarious media circus filled with shocking local and celebrity candidates.
response.title: South Park: Cartman's Mom Is A Dirty Slut
